name: 45242 · Cincinnati, OH
findings: ZIP 45242 (Cincinnati) has 198 nonprofit organizations. 90 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 68 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45242 (Cincinnati) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45242 (Cincinnati) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 68 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
